# Alessio Maiola

> Software Engineer specialized in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning
> and Cybersecurity. Master's graduate in Engineering in Computer Science from
> Sapienza University of Rome (110/110 cum laude). CTF player with team TRX and
> winner of CyberChallenge.IT 2025.

Personal portfolio at https://siralex01.github.io. Based in Rome, Italy.

## Profile

- Role: Cyber Technology Researcher at Leonardo (Rome, Italy), from June 2026.
- Previously: Software Engineer at Daikin Applied Europe (Sep 2025 - Jun 2026).
- Education: MSc Engineering in Computer Science, Sapienza University of Rome
  (2023-2025, 110/110 cum laude); BSc Computer and Automation Engineering,
  Sapienza (2020-2023, 110/110 cum laude); IELTS Academic C1 (7.5/9.0).
- Master's thesis: An AI framework for Linear B translation into Ancient Greek
  and English.
- Bachelor's thesis: Change detection on satellite images using neural networks.

## Focus areas

- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: reinforcement learning, deep
  learning architectures (CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformers), computer vision,
  natural language processing, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn.
- Cybersecurity and ethical hacking: CTF challenges across crypto, pwn, web and
  reverse engineering; binary exploitation; cryptanalysis; web exploitation.
- Software engineering and DevOps: system design, distributed systems, Docker,
  Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD.
- Data and database systems, networking, and full stack web engineering.

## Competitive results

- First place, CyberChallenge.IT 2025 national finals (Attack/Defense, CINI),
  against 40+ Italian universities, representing Team Sapienza.
- Best Presentation Award and Best Defense Award, CyberChallenge.IT 2025.
- Top 5% of 1000+ participants in the CyberChallenge.IT 2025 Jeopardy
  qualification phase.
- Team wins with TRX in the 2025 editions of CrewCTF, SnakeCTF and LITCTF.
